sql: UPDATE assets SET is_flight_asset = 1, is_simulator = 1, sim_rate = 50, hobbs_hours = 500.0, tach_hours = 480.0 WHERE id = {asset}

INSERT INTO scheduled_flights (asset_id, student_id, cfi_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, duration_hours, status) VALUES ({asset}, {student}, {cfi}, date('now','localtime'), strftime('%H:%M', 'now','localtime'), 1.0, 'scheduled')
